description: Melbourne Psychotherapist, Counsellor & Relationship Therapist | Gottman-Trained | EMDR | LGBTQIA+ & BIPOC-Owned Working holistically across relationship and individual concerns, Kevin integrates Gottman Method, humanistic, EMDR, somatic and a broad range of approaches, including Eastern philosophies like mindfulness and meditation — tailored to each client rather than applied as a formula. He works with all relationship structures — monogamous, ethically non-monogamous, polyamorous, and LGBTQIA+ partnerships — and supports individuals navigating anxiety, depression, trauma, identity, cultural transitions, and personal growth. His practice is queer-led, BIPOC-owned, kink-aware, and culturally responsive — a genuinely inclusive space where clients from all backgrounds, identities, and relationship styles are welcome.
specialties: emdr, kink, lgbtqia+, queer, sex, sexual, sexuality, trauma
